plants.title: Blackwell
plants.summary: Nvidia's current GPU. 72 to a GB300 NVL72 rack.
plants.dek: GB300 NVL72: 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, 20 TB of GPU memory, 130 TB/s NVLink, and 1,440 PFLOPS FP4 with sparsity.
plants.label: GPUs · GB300 NVL72
plants.imageAlt: NVIDIA Blackwell GPU package render: the compute silicon in the center with four memory stacks above and four below, inside a gold frame.

plants.title: Rubin
plants.summary: Nvidia's next GPU, with 288 GB of HBM4. 72 to a Vera Rubin NVL72 rack.
plants.dek: 50 PFLOPS of NVFP4 inference and 288 GB of HBM4 on the Rubin GPU. Vera Rubin NVL72 is 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs.
plants.label: NVFP4 inference · Rubin GPU
plants.imageAlt: NVIDIA Rubin GPU package render: the compute silicon in the center with four memory stacks above and four below, inside a silver frame on a black background.

plants.title: Instinct
plants.summary: AMD's GPU line. A custom MI450 powers Meta's first gigawatt.
plants.dek: Custom MI450 GPU for Meta's first gigawatt, with Helios racks. MI300 and MI350 are the series Meta already runs.
plants.label: Custom Instinct GPU
plants.imageAlt: AMD Instinct MI350-series accelerator module: a black board with the AMD logo, memory around a silver frame, and a blue, green, and orange compute die, on a black background.

plants.title: Ironwood
plants.summary: Google's seventh-generation TPU, rented by the chip-hour.
plants.dek: Google's seventh-generation TPU, with Trillium (TPU v6e) as the generation before. $12 per chip-hour on demand in us-central1, $5.40 on a three-year commitment.
plants.label: On demand per chip-hour · us-central1
plants.imageAlt: Google Ironwood TPU: a metal-framed chip with amber silicon and the word Ironwood printed on the frame, on a black background.

spec.price: $12 per chip-hour, on demand, us-central1, Google list price

plants.title: Intel GPU D270
plants.summary: Intel's inference GPU on LPDDR5X, not HBM. Customer sampling underway.
plants.dek: GPU D-series, code name Crescent Island. Intel states 1.3 PFLOPS FP8, 160 GB LPDDR5X on Intel's card, up to 480 GB on partner cards, 1.5 TB/s, 350 W air-cooled PCIe 5.0.
plants.label: FP8 · per card · Intel

spec.compute: 1.3 PFLOPS FP8, dense or sparse not stated
spec.memory: 160 GB LPDDR5X (Intel card); up to 480 GB on partner cards

plants.title: Trainium2
plants.summary: AWS's own chip. Nearly 500,000 run Project Rainier for Anthropic.
plants.dek: Annapurna Labs chip for AWS. 96 GiB of HBM per chip, 64 chips to a Trn2 UltraServer. Project Rainier runs nearly 500,000 of them for Anthropic.
plants.label: Dense FP8 · per chip · AWS
plants.imageAlt: AWS Trainium2 chip package: two silicon compute dies, each flanked by memory stacks, inside a silver frame stamped with the Annapurna Labs logo, on a black background.

plants.title: Maia 200 and Maia 300
plants.summary: Maia 200 in production. Maia 300 announced 12 Oct 2026, deploys from 2027.
plants.dek: Microsoft's inference chip. TSMC 3nm, 216 GB of HBM3e at 7 TB/s, 750 W. Deploying across the US, Europe, and Australia per Microsoft (12 Oct 2026). Maia 300 announced 12 Oct 2026: 288 GB HBM4 at 18 TB/s, 950 W, production deployments from 2027.
plants.label: FP4 · per chip · Microsoft
plants.imageAlt: Microsoft Maia 200 chip: a silver-framed package with Microsoft Azure Maia 200 printed on the silicon lid.

plants.title: MTIA
plants.summary: Meta's own chip family. The MTIA 300 is in production.
plants.dek: 300, 400, 450, and 500. The 300 is in production with 216 GB HBM3E. The 400 is a 72-accelerator rack. Compute FLOPS from the 300 to the 500 is 25x.
plants.label: HBM3E · MTIA 300
plants.imageAlt: Meta MTIA chip package: blue-tinted silicon and memory stacks inside a blue frame, on a black background.

plants.title: WSE-3
plants.summary: One chip the size of a whole silicon wafer.
plants.dek: One chip the size of a silicon wafer: 4 trillion transistors and 44 GB of on-chip SRAM. 125 PFLOPS peak AI on the WSE-3, 250 on the WSE-3 Turbo.
plants.label: AI cores · one wafer · Cerebras
plants.imageAlt: Cerebras WSE-3 Turbo wafer, a single dinner-plate-size chip

spec.compute: 125 PFLOPS peak AI, format not named

plants.title: Ascend 910C
plants.summary: Huawei's AI chip. Up to 384 in one Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD.
plants.dek: Huawei's current AI chip. Up to 384 in one Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD, rated up to 307.2 PFLOPS of FP16, with 128 GB of memory per chip.
plants.label: Chips · Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD

plants.title: Jalapeño
plants.summary: OpenAI's first own inference chip, built with Broadcom.
plants.dek: OpenAI's first custom inference chip, built with Broadcom. 13.4 PFLOPS MXFP4, 216 GiB HBM4 at 15.4 TB/s, 700 W. Deploying in OpenAI's data centers by end of 2026, per OpenAI.
plants.label: MXFP4 · per chip · OpenAI

plants.title: Trainium3
plants.summary: AWS's first 3nm AI chip. Up to 144 in a Trn3 UltraServer.
plants.dek: AWS's fourth-generation AI chip. 2.52 PFLOPS MXFP8, 144 GiB HBM3e at 4.9 TB/s. Up to 144 chips in a Trn3 UltraServer.
plants.label: MXFP8 · per chip · AWS

plants.title: TPU 8t and 8i
plants.dek: Google's eighth-generation TPUs, split in two. TPU 8i: 288 GB HBM and 384 MB SRAM. TPU 8t: 9,600-chip superpods at 121 EFLOPS. Generally available later in 2026, per Google.
plants.label: HBM · TPU 8i · Google

spec.note: Google has not printed per-chip compute or bandwidth.

plants.title: MI455X and Helios
plants.summary: AMD's top Instinct GPU. 72 to a Helios rack.
plants.dek: AMD Instinct MI455X: 40 PFLOPS FP4, 432 GB HBM4 at 23.3 TB/s. 72 per Helios rack: 2.9 EFLOPS FP4, 31 TB HBM4. Volume deployments expected 2H 2026, per AMD.
plants.label: FP4 · per GPU · AMD

plants.title: Groq 3 LPX
plants.summary: Nvidia's SRAM inference rack. 256 LPUs beside Vera Rubin.
plants.dek: 256 Groq 3 LPUs per rack, 500 MB SRAM per chip, 128 GB SRAM and 315 PFLOPS FP8 per rack. Pairs with Vera Rubin NVL72. In full production, per Nvidia (24 Aug 2026).
plants.label: FP8 · per rack · Nvidia
